meta.pageTitle: Girls in TechNeekX (GIT) | Women in Tech & Leadership
meta.heading: Girls in TechNeekX
meta.subheading: Breaking Stereotypes. Engineering Tomorrow. Leading with Purpose.
meta.description: Celebrating the brilliant female engineers, designers, researchers, and leaders shaping TechNeekX. We champion unapologetic feminism in tech—ensuring equal opportunity, autonomous leadership, and technical excellence.
meta.quote: “Feminism isn't about making women stronger. Women are already strong. It's about changing the way the world perceives that strength in tech and innovation.”

feministPillars.title: Equal Code, Equal Voice
feministPillars.description: Women at TechNeekX don't just participate; they architect systems, write production backend pipelines, and lead high-stakes technical decisions.

feministPillars.title: Shattering The Glass Ceiling
feministPillars.description: From Director of Operations to AI/ML Leads and Creative Directors, our leadership roster proves that modern tech flourishes when women hold the helm.

feministPillars.title: Sisterhood in STEM
feministPillars.description: We foster a supportive, zero-gatekeeping community where senior female mentors train, debug with, and champion junior builders stepping into the field.

feministPillars.title: Tangible Impact over Tokenism
feministPillars.description: Every achievement highlighted here represents real sleepless hackathon nights, functional repositories, deployed platforms, and impactful community events.

trailblazers.name: Arpita Sharma
trailblazers.alt: Portrait of Arpita Sharma, Director of Core Operations at TechNeekX
trailblazers.bio: Strategic powerhouse orchestrating TechNeekX's internal operations, partner relations, and massive hackathons. Skilled in ORM, team coordination, and scaling youth initiatives.
trailblazers.quote: Leadership is not about demanding authority; it is about building an ecosystem where every girl coder feels powerful enough to innovate without hesitation.
achievements: Head of Operations for the InnVedX Hackathon hosting 491+ participants across multiple technical tracks.
Built standardized cross-team operational workflows bridging design, dev, and media departments.
Drove community engagement initiatives that onboarded dozens of prospective female developers.

trailblazers.name: Sneha Yadav
trailblazers.alt: Portrait of Sneha Yadav, Design Lead and Software Developer at TechNeekX
trailblazers.bio: Passionate 2nd-year B.Tech computer science engineer fusing technical precision in Java and DSA with intuitive, aesthetically striking UI/UX design.
trailblazers.quote: Great software is both functional and empathetic. As women designers and engineers, we bring distinct human intuition and relentless craftsmanship to the screen.
achievements: Led creative direction and design judging for the 'Vibe Designing' university competition with 100+ participants.
Co-designed sleek component systems and user journeys for TechNeekX platforms and community hubs.
Mentors first-year women builders in Git, GitHub, Java foundations, and modern design principles.

trailblazers.name: Arshi
trailblazers.alt: Portrait of Arshi, Media Lead and Creative Storyteller at TechNeekX
trailblazers.bio: Computer Science student and creative director blending coding prowess, data science curiosities, and cinematic video editing to define the TechNeekX visual brand.
trailblazers.quote: Storytelling is how we rewrite the narrative in STEM. When young girls witness women commanding cameras, timelines, and terminals, they realize there are no boundaries.
achievements: Headed digital media and cinematic recaps for flagship events including Frame by Frame and Kalpathon 2.0.
Grew community social engagement across digital channels with viral tech reels and event teasers.
Built compelling visual narratives celebrating women hackers and team milestones.

trailblazers.name: Kriti Jain
trailblazers.alt: Portrait of Kriti Jain, AI/ML Lead and Backend Engineer at TechNeekX
trailblazers.bio: B.Tech CSE engineer deeply immersed in backend architecture, AI algorithms, neural network fine-tuning, and scalable predictive systems.
trailblazers.quote: The algorithms of tomorrow must be coded by diverse minds today. Women in AI are not consumers of technology—we are the architects of intelligence.
achievements: Key contributor to intelligent backend pipelines and machine learning experiments in the community.
Active podium contender and technical lead in collegiate competitive programming and hackathon sprints.
Conducts hands-on machine learning problem-solving sessions for junior tech enthusiasts.

trailblazers.name: Akshara Dixit
trailblazers.alt: Portrait of Akshara Dixit, AI-ML Lead and Data Scientist at TechNeekX
trailblazers.bio: Aspiring Data Scientist with sharp analytical rigor, passionate about exploring datasets, AI innovation, and solving complex human problems collaboratively.
trailblazers.quote: Data is the voice of our world. When women interpret that voice, we build tech that is fairer, smarter, and deeply impactful.
achievements: Core technical lead in the 8-hour intensive TNX Codathon hosting 148 collegiate builders.
Developed end-to-end data preprocessing and exploratory models for AI track projects.
Pioneering voice for inclusivity and technical rigor among first-generation female techies.

trailblazers.name: Harshita Agnihotri
trailblazers.alt: Portrait of Harshita Agnihotri, Research & Analysis Lead and AIML Mentor at TechNeekX
trailblazers.bio: 4th-year B.Tech CSE-AI scholar at Babu Banarasi Das University. Dedicated researcher, keynote speaker, and mentor cultivating the next generation of engineers.
trailblazers.quote: Knowledge expands when you share it freely. True feminism in tech means holding the door wide open and pulling every sister up with you.
achievements: Mentored 100+ student developers across computer vision, NLP, and model evaluation techniques.
Headed technical analysis on generative AI models and intelligent system scalability.
Key mentor and judge for university-wide coding initiatives and research presentations.

milestones.title: InnVedX Hackathon Operations Triumph
milestones.description: Orchestrated by Arpita Sharma and our operations squad, InnVedX became one of the largest student hackathons at BBD University, delivering seamless logistics and real-world coding tracks.
milestones.alt: Participants collaborating at InnVedX Hackathon organized by TechNeekX female leaders

milestones.title: Vibe Designing UI/UX Championship
milestones.description: Spearheaded by Design Lead Sneha Yadav, Vibe Designing challenged designers to construct accessible, modern design systems under intense time constraints, judged with meticulous standards.
milestones.alt: Designers competing at the Vibe Designing UI/UX event led by Sneha Yadav

milestones.title: TNX Codathon AI Sprint Execution
milestones.description: Hosted at SRMCEM Lucknow, our female AI leads—Kriti Jain, Akshara Dixit, and mentor Harshita Agnihotri—guided dozens of teams building LLM agents, cognitive workflows, and neural models.
milestones.alt: Crowded hackathon hall at TNX Codathon with female AI leads mentoring coders
milestones.leadBy: Kriti Jain, Akshara Dixit & Harshita Agnihotri

milestones.title: Frame by Frame Creative Sprint
milestones.description: Led by Arshi (Media Lead), this hands-on media production summit empowered creators to merge visual aesthetics, video editing, and tech storytelling for high impact.
milestones.alt: Media and photography gear showcase during the Frame by Frame event directed by Arshi

milestones.title: Kalpathon 2.0 24-Hour Code Odyssey
milestones.description: A grueling 24-hour overnight national hackathon where female builders stood on the frontlines—coordinating mentorship, validating repo submissions, and building award-winning solutions.
milestones.alt: Teams hacking overnight during the 24-hour Kalpathon 2.0 hackathon

milestones.title: SheMentors 1-on-1 Code Labs
milestones.description: A dedicated mentorship track pairing incoming female university students with our senior leads to master Git, DSA, Full-Stack development, and AI engineering without fear.
milestones.alt: TechNeekX mentorship session connecting senior female mentors with junior builders
milestones.leadBy: Harshita Agnihotri, Sneha Yadav & Arpita Sharma

feministManifesto.title: Our Feminist Tech Manifesto
feministManifesto.lead: We believe technology is humanity's highest leverage tool—and it should never be defined by gender stereotyping or glass ceilings.

points.title: Radical Inclusivity
points.description: Every project, repo, and initiative actively welcomes and equips female developers, designers, and organizers.

points.title: Autonomy in Leadership
points.description: Women don't just hold titles here—they make budget calls, set technical architecture, and dictate operational policy.

points.title: Zero Gatekeeping
points.description: From 'How to create your first GitHub PR' to 'Deploying transformer models on GPUs', knowledge is shared transparently.

points.title: Amplifying Visibility
points.description: We ensure women speak on stages, receive public recognition for their commits, and build portfolios that open doors globally.

ctaSection.title: Ready to Write Your Chapter in Tech?
ctaSection.subtitle: Join Girls in TechNeekX. Build production AI, enter national hackathons, and shape the future of technology with sisters who have your back.
